journey.name: Settings export backup
journey.description: Export end-to-end (issue #26): open app, go to Settings, export a JSON backup through the system file picker, and verify the result dialog names the saved backup file.

actions.action: Launch Snake Tracker; verify the Calendar tab is shown with its title.
Tap the Settings tab in the bottom navigation bar; verify the Settings screen opens with an "Export backup" row.
Tap the "Export backup" row; verify the system create-document (Storage Access Framework) picker opens offering a JSON file named "snake-tracker-backup-<today's date in yyyy-MM-dd>.json".
Choose a save location (for example the Downloads folder), accept the suggested file name, and confirm; verify a "Backup saved" dialog appears whose message names the saved backup file.
Tap OK in the dialog; verify the dialog closes and the Settings screen is visible again.
